title: The lacunary variety is a coset-UNION, so I(delta) is an EXACT binomial C(n/2^L,(k+t)/2^L) -- not the exponential tower budget
evidence: Exact integer enumeration over dyadic mu_n in the prize regime (proper subgroup, q prime = 1 mod n). Probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C003_coset_union_exact_binomial.py enumerates the FULL variety {S subset mu_n : |S|=k+t, e_1=...=e_{t-1}=0 mod q} and compares to the claimed binomial C(n/2^L,(k+t)/2^L), L=ceil(log2 t), and to the set of 2^L-coset unions. The reverse direction (every variety element is a 2^L-coset union) is exactly TopLine.full_tower, which is proven only in CHARACTERISTIC ZERO; over F_q it FAILS, so the variety is strictly larger than the coset unions and the count is q-DEPENDENT. Decisive counterexamples (all at t=2, L=1, 2^L=2, where the variety is {|S|=a, e_1=0}): (n=16,a=4,t=2): #variety = 44 at q=97 but C(8,2)=28 (16 extra non-antipodal sets). (n=16,a=6,t=2): #variety = 136 (q=97), 72 (q=193), 56 (q=257=char-0 value) -- the SAME (n,a,t) gives THREE different counts, directly contradicting q-independence. Divisibility over-claim: at (n=16,k=3,t=2,a=5) 2^L does NOT divide a so the coset-union/binomial count is 0, yet #variety = 16 over q=97 and q=193 -- the variety is nonzero where the formula predicts zero. Forward direction (coset unions subset variety) holds in all 0 failures, matching the proven coset_union_esymm_zero. Companion probe C003_char0_vs_charp.py recomputes the SAME varieties exactly in Z[zeta_n] (char 0) and gets variety == coset-unions in every case (28,56,6,4,...): the binomial is a CHARACTERISTIC-0 fact, false over F_q. Explicit char-p escape witness: S={1,8,18,70} subset mu_16 over F_97 has sum = 0 mod 97 (e_1=0) but is not closed under negation, hence not a 2^L-coset union, hence uncounted by the binomial.
wall: BGK / char-p transfer (relation-free transfer of Lam-Leung): the extra variety elements over F_q are exactly the short low-weight {-1,0,1}-relations of 2^mu-th roots of unity that vanish mod the prize prime but not in char 0. Counting them = the open core, identical to the GaussianEnergyBound / relation-free-transfer wall flagged throughout the campaign.
honest_note: What IS true and proven (in-tree, char 0): (a) forward direction coset_union_esymm_zero -- 2^L-coset unions always lie in the variety (verified, 0 failures over F_q too); (b) full_tower -- in CHARACTERISTIC ZERO the variety EXACTLY equals the coset unions, so the binomial C(n/2^L,(k+t)/2^L) is correct there. The C003 over-claim is conflating that char-0 exact count with the char-p count I(delta) over F_q in the prize regime. Over F_q the count is (i) strictly larger than the binomial, (ii) q-DEPENDENT, and (iii) nonzero even when 2^L does not divide k+t (where the binomial is 0). So the claim 'I(delta) is an EXACT binomial, q-independent, off the analytic wall' is false; the residual welds back to the same char-p escape / BGK transfer wall. Probes are exact integer arithmetic, n in {4,8,16}, multiple proper-subgroup primes; tested t up to 7 and several rates. Recommend logging the char-p escape counterexample to DISPROOF_LOG. Scripts: scripts/probes/_407_conn/C003_coset_union_exact_binomial.py and C003_char0_vs_charp.py.
